title: Lanterns Beneath the Flood
description: Swim through offset wall openings, manage currents, and change depth throughout the route. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The flooded entrance
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The descending lock
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

Between the sunken beams
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The bell chamber
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

Against the sluice current
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The last submerged passage
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The flooded entrance
rooms.lesson: Swim up to the first opening · down to the next. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The descending lock
rooms.lesson: Follow the openings down through the lock. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Between the sunken beams
rooms.lesson: Reverse depth between the long beams. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The bell chamber
rooms.lesson: Climb to the bell chamber, then dive to the outlet. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Against the sluice current
rooms.lesson: Use the open chamber to steady yourself before each current. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The last submerged passage
rooms.lesson: Follow the lanterns through the final changes in depth. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
